record.original_question: An embedding ι: N → M of II_1 factors is called existential if there exists an embedding M ⊂ N^U whose restriction to N agrees with the diagonal embedding induced by ι. Does there exist a separable II_1 factor N that admits an existential embedding of L(F_2) into N but is not isomorphic to any nontrivial free product?

evidence.quote: Recall that an embedding of ι : N ,→ M is existential if there is an embedding of M ⊂ NU that restricts to the diagonal embedding under ι.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Background and definitions. Let M and N be tracial von Neumann algebras whose underlying algebras are II_1 factors (i.e. infinite-dimensional factors of type II_1, equipped with their unique faithful normal tracial state τ). Fix a free ultrafilter U on the natural numbers, and let N^U denote the tracial ultrapower of N: the quotient of the algebra of bounded sequences (x_n) in N by the ideal of sequences with ||x_n||_2 → 0 along U, where ||x||_2 = τ(x*x)^{1/2}. Inside N^U sits the diagonal copy of N, sending a ∈ N to the class of the constant sequence (a,a,a,…).

An embedding ι : N → M of II_1 factors is called existential if there exists an embedding j : M → N^U such that j ∘ ι coincides with the diagonal embedding N → N^U.

A II_1 factor N is said to be a nontrivial free product if there exist diffuse tracial von Neumann subalgebras A, B ⊂ N (each different from N and from C) such that N is canonically isomorphic to the tracial free product A * B.

Let L(F_2) denote the group von Neumann algebra of the free group F_2 on two generators (with its canonical trace).

Question. Does there exist a separable II_1 factor N such that:
(i) there is an existential embedding L(F_2) → N (in the sense above), and
(ii) N is not isomorphic to any nontrivial tracial free product A * B of diffuse tracial von Neumann algebras?
artifact.status_search_result: The problem appears in a recent compilation of 50 open problems on ultraproduct II_1 factors and is stated explicitly as an open problem. Related literature on existentially closed II_1 factors and existential embeddings (Farah–Goldbring–Hart–Sherman and subsequent works) discusses adjacent questions but does not resolve this one. No published resolution was found.

status_evidence.title: Existentially Closed II_1 Factors
status_evidence.snippet: Develops the model-theoretic notion of existential embeddings between II_1 factors and discusses properties of L(F_2) and free products in this framework.
status_evidence.claim: The notion of existential embedding studied in the problem is established in the literature, but the specific question about a separable N that is not a nontrivial free product is not resolved there.

status_evidence.title: Existential closedness and the structure of bimodules of II_1 factors
status_evidence.snippet: Studies existential closedness for II_1 factors and bimodule structure; related to but does not settle the existence of such N.
status_evidence.claim: Recent work on existential closedness does not resolve Problem 7 about separable factors admitting existential embeddings of L(F_2) without being nontrivial free products.
